text: {"lessons":["My account rose early, then fell for several months and recovered somewhat; this short record does not make recent price changes useful predictions of what comes next.","Doing nothing avoided impulsive reactions, but I should still review whether my holdings and cash fit my plan rather than treating inaction as a strategy by itself.","Because losses weigh heavily on me and selling at a loss is painful, I should decide based on future prospects, risk and diversification—not on my purchase price or the urge to lock in gains."]}
